title: DESCRIPTION
source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS:*

* Correction the LITERACY, NUMERACY, HINDI, DRAW, ART & CRAFT & PHONICS question paper for grade NUR to K2 for the Post-Mid Term Exam.
* Printed the Post-Mid Term LITERACY, NUMERACY, HINDI, DRAW, ART & CRAFT & PHONICS questions paper for grade NUR to K2 for the 2nd proofing.
* Uploaded the student's (Aadhar & Caste certificate) on the Eduletics portal.
* Give the students' APAAR IDs to their parents.(ID-646, 647, 3469).
* Scanned the Grade XI MATHS, CHEMISTRY & PHYSICS answer copy (ID-4688) and Grade IX MATHS, CHEMISTRY, PHYSICS, BIOLOGY & SST answer copy (ID-4675) and converted it into a PDF and shared it with Vivek Sir.
* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student.(ID-1788)
* Updated the Excel sheet with the Grade IX registration data.

*OTHER WORK:*

* Dispersal Duty.
* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
* Collected homework feedback from the first-floor classes and shared it via a Google Form.
